# Conventions & Best Practices

- **TDD & 3A Pattern**: Tests must follow Arrange-Act-Assert. Use isolated fixtures per test (a fresh temp SQLite file for `GraphStore`, or a fresh `TestSandbox` directory for CLI subprocess tests) to avoid state pollution — see `testing_and_quality.md` for the concrete patterns.
- **Constructor Injection, No Internal Construction**: Every service dependency is a required constructor parameter (no defaults); no service constructs its own dependencies. See `architecture.md` for the composition-root-function convention this supports.
- **Single-Connection Data Access**: All SQLite access goes through `GraphStore`'s narrow, typed repo methods (`lib/core/src/memory/repos/`) — there is no generic raw-SQL escape hatch and no per-service DB connection.
- **No New CLI Commands When an Existing One Fits**: New background-processing capability (e.g. Tier B and Tier C of the background-knowledge-evolution rollout — see `architecture.md`) is folded into the existing `analyze --escalate-to-lsp && snapshot` composition rather than adding a new command or flag. Prefer extending an existing command's behavior over adding a parallel one whenever the user-facing "sentence" describing the action stays the same.
- **Invariant-Violation Guard Idiom**: when a function's correctness depends on an implicit precondition (e.g. commit-graph ordering, a schema-version stamp), the established shape in this codebase is "detect the violation → log a specific message/event constant → fall back to a safer full re-computation," not a bespoke pattern per case. `run-delta-ingestion.ts` has two instances of exactly this shape: `isNodeKeyFormatStale` (stale node-key format) and the `isAncestor` backward-`HEAD` guard (added 2026-08-04, see `common_errors.md`) — both fall back to `runFullIngestion()`. Reuse this shape for future gaps in the same function/family rather than inventing a new one.
